summary: Team RBAC audit (Task 2, P0 Fix Task List v2) verified end-to-end via 11 automated pytest tests + Mongo-backed invite token retrieval. All acceptance criteria pass: invite/accept flow, viewer blocked on 3 write endpoints with permission_denied body, viewer reads OWNER's real data on 3 read endpoints (fix-pipeline/quota, payments/my-plan, cto/projects/connection-status — no empty own-user bucket), promoting to editor unblocks writes (not permission_denied any more), editor still 403 on team/invite (resource=team_management), account owner regression on 5+ endpoints, and solo (non-team) user unaffected.

minor.issue: Pydantic body validation returns 422 BEFORE the RBAC gate runs, so a viewer sending a malformed body sees 422 instead of 403 permission_denied. This is FastAPI's standard ordering (schema-before-handler) and not a security gap — the gate still fires whenever the body is valid — but if you want RBAC-first denial for observability, move check_permission before the Pydantic-body dep. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: services/team_permissions.py: the `isinstance(member_row, dict)` guard against bare AsyncMock() dbs is the correct fix and is well-commented — good defensive design.

Minor: `require_permission` docstring says level accepts 'read'/'write' but the RESOURCES matrix uses levels 'read'/'read_write' — the _satisfies() helper correctly bridges (read_write satisfies both). Consistent, but could confuse a first-time reader.

Consider: for write endpoints that use Pydantic-heavy bodies, adding an explicit dependency-order note or moving the permission dep to a FastAPI Depends() so 403s aren't masked by 422s. Non-blocking, aesthetic.
test_credentials: Fresh throwaway accounts created via /api/aurem-dev/auth/signup with unique per-run tag (rbaczz<hex>) and cleaned up in module teardown. Same pattern documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: One owner + one viewer/editor team member + one solo user, all tagged with a per-run uuid and deleted by the module-scoped `db` fixture. No production data touched. No Stripe checkout completed (test only asserts response shape).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression test lives at backend/tests/test_team_rbac_audit_2026_01.py. Run with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_team_rbac_audit_2026_01.py -v` (must cd into backend/ so conftest.py can resolve the `services` module). Test hits real preview backend + real Mongo for invite-token retrieval. Cleans up its own throwaway accounts on tear-down.
rca of the issue: N/A — task was verification only; the main agent's RBAC audit (~19 routers patched with check_permission + effective_account_id swap) is confirmed correct and non-regressing. The one 422-before-403 quirk on hosted-deploy/connect is FastAPI validation ordering, not an RBAC gap.
